mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jm_table_association (id, name, description, data_source_id, sql_template, config_json, physical_table, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{dataSourceId}, #{sqlTemplate}, #{configJson}, #{physicalTable}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, data_source_id AS dataSourceId, sql_template AS sqlTemplate, config_json AS configJson, physical_table AS physicalTable, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM jm_table_association WHERE id = #{id}
